Using the identified coordinates:
\[
D=\left(\frac12,\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right),\quad C=(1,0),\quad B=(1,-1).
\]
Then
\[
\overrightarrow{DC}=\left(\frac12,-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)
\]
has direction \(-60^\circ\).

Also
\[
\overrightarrow{DB}=\left(\frac12,-1-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)
\]
has direction \(-75^\circ\), since its slope is \(-2-\sqrt3=\tan(-75^\circ)\).

Thus
\[
m\angle CDB=|-60^\circ-(-75^\circ)|=15^\circ.
\]
\[
\boxed{15}
\]
